svg.title: Worker: one activation
svg.desc: The loop of one activation (one asyncio task): open the conversation, think, account, act, tidy up, merge; plus the append-only conversation and on-demand compaction.
svg.text: Worker · one activation = one asyncio task
Append-only conversation → model → tools → merge, looping until the agent calls sleep; no round cap, and no fewer wake-ups to save money.
begin_run resets the per-run state. No conversation in
the ConversationBook yet → create it: system + tools
(byte-stable from now on) + a FULL start_message;
otherwise append a DELTA inject_message, and if
there is nothing to tell, make no model call and go back
whole conversation goes to the model as it is (through

stopped) → drop the result, write nothing.

Run every tool call in order, synchronously (no await,
so it can never be cancelled half-way), then append the

What the Brain tells the model
FULL (first message): the board (can I speak now, floors,
open requests, abilities, tags) · the hard-facts table ·
private notes and compaction summary · visible history
DELTA (every later activation or merge): entries after
seen_seq · actionable changes of the board (diff_board)
· wake reasons; nothing new, nothing sent. When it is a
bot's turn to speak or answer, the message ends with a
short hint (never in the system prompt).
What players write is always treated as untrusted data;
people are called N3 Carol (ids in tool arguments, names
The pending mailbox · scheduling one activation (call_soon) · cancellation
and the starvation guard · retry on failure · the sleep alarm · stop.
Synchronous, never calls the LLM, never blocks.
Open the conversation → model → tools → merge → tidy, until sleep. gen is
checked when the model call returns; a failure only affects this agent, and a
cancelled Worker's result is never written into the world.
